title: Aparigraha
tagline: Non-possessiveness — living with an open hand
description: Non-possessiveness — living with an open hand

sections.theme: Five vows for a life well-lived.

sutra.meaning: Ahimsa (non-violence/non-injury), Satya (truthfulness), Asteya (non-stealing), Brahmacharya (right use of energy/continence), and Aparigraha (non-possessiveness/non-greed) are the five Yamas (restraints or social codes)
sutra.padaVibhaga: ahiṁsā | satya | asteya | brahmacarya | aparigrahāḥ | yamāḥ
sutra.wordMeanings: ahiṁsā = non-violence; satya = truthfulness; asteya = non-stealing; brahmacarya = continence; aparigrahāḥ = non-possessiveness; yamāḥ = restraints

sections.reflectionPrompt: Did I live these today? Which can I work on? Which is difficult for me?
sections.practice: Observe yourself and note how many times you strayed or were tempted to stray from adhering to the Yamas
sections.journalPrompt: Which of the Yamas did I not follow.
sections.gurudevInsight: Ahimasa, satya, Ashteya, Brahmacharya, Aparigraha. Ahimsa - nonviolence Satya - Truth Astheya - non stealing Brahmacharya - moving in Brahman, moving in the bigness. jaatideshkaalsamayanva chinahsaalbhauka mahavrutta These are the greatest because it is applicable in all time in all places for all people throughout, without an interruption. There are certain laws, which can apply just to certain people, certain places, at certain time, which are not universal, but these are universal a) Ahimsa: - These 5 Principles. An animal does not go into violence for no reason. Animals hunt, even the wild animals, they hunt only when they are hungry & when they want to eat. [PDF p.81]

sutra.wordMeanings: aparigraha = non-possessiveness; sthairye = in steadiness; janma = birth; kathaṁtā = how-ness; saṁbodhaḥ = illumination

sections.gurudevInsight: When you do not accumulate, then the knowledge of the previous births, knowledge of different species, the communication in you improves. Do you see what I am saying? When, a person says "more for me, more for me", then he is obsessed with fear, one does not know the eternal value of life. Life has been there for ages and will continue for ages to come.

sutra.meaning: "Being established in non-accumulation gives knowledge of how births happen."
sutra.wordMeanings: aparigraha = non-possessiveness; sthairye = in steadiness; janma = birth; kathaṁtā = how-ness; saṁbodhaḥ = illumination

sections.reflectionPrompt: Do I feel sufficient and content.
sections.gurudevInsight: Aparigraha (Non-accumulation): - When you do not accumulate, then you get the knowledge of previous birth, knowledge of different species, the communication in you improves. When a person thinks more for me, more for me, just me, me, me, then he is obsessed with fear. One does not know the eternal value of life. Life has been there from ages & will continue for ages to come. Non-accumulation simply means confidence in one’s existence, confidence in one’s ability, knowledge of one’s Self.

sutra.meaning: Knowledge of past and future lives unfold when one is free from greed for possessions.
sutra.wordMeanings: aparigraha = non-possessiveness; sthairye = in steadiness; janma = birth; kathaṁtā = how-ness; saṁbodhaḥ = illumination

sections.insight: Aparigraha also means freedom from rigidity of thought. Holding on to ones thoughts and perceptions is also a form of possessiveness.
sections.reflectionPrompt: What all do I  hold onto?
sections.gurudevInsight: But normally animals, they just eat or mate in time, they eat in time, rest in time, they have no choice but human beings have this freedom to eat whenever they want, do whatever they want. This freedom is given along with the discrimination, along with the wisdom, along with the consequences of action, knowledge of consequences of action. So that a human can use & live its life with wisdom. Specialty of human life is governed by viveka, wisdom, discrimination. Once the sapling has come, they will keep me watered again & again, it works. A seed has the possibility that if it is not watered, then the possibility remains a possibility, it doesn’t manifest.
